theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Don't Mean Your Money Disappears
body: Volatility is normal market behavior. Panic selling locks in losses. Staying invested helps you weather temporary fluctuations.
caption: Markets go up and down regularly. This doesn't mean your investments lose value permanently. Emotional decisions during downturns often hurt long-term returns. #BehavioralFinance #InvestmentWisdom #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #LongTermThinking
